title: Current Electricity - Series, Parallel and Formula Rearrangement
topic: D.C. Circuits and Combined Formula Applications
subject: Combined Physics

questions.question: In a series circuit, the current is...
questions.explanation: In a series circuit, there is only one path for current, so the current is the same at every point.

questions.question: In a parallel circuit, the potential difference across each branch is...
options: Largest for the branch with most resistance
questions.explanation: In a parallel circuit, all branches are connected across the same two points, so the potential difference is the same across each branch.

questions.question: Two resistors, 4 Ω and 6 Ω, are connected in series. What is the total resistance?
questions.explanation: For series: R_total = R1 + R2 = 4 Ω + 6 Ω = 10 Ω.

questions.question: Two resistors, 4 Ω and 6 Ω, are connected in parallel. What is the total resistance?
A 12 V battery is connected to two 6 Ω resistors in series. What is the current?
questions.explanation: Total R = 6 + 6 = 12 Ω. I = V/R = 12 V / 12 Ω = 1 A.

questions.question: A 12 V battery is connected to two 6 Ω resistors in parallel. What is the total current from the battery?
questions.explanation: For parallel: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/6 = 2/6 = 1/3, so R = 3 Ω. I = V/R = 12 V / 3 Ω = 4 A.

questions.question: A charge of 120 C passes through a circuit in 2 minutes. What is the current in amperes?
questions.explanation: Time = 2 min = 120 s. I = Q/t = 120 C / 120 s = 1 A.

questions.question: A lamp has a potential difference of 6 V and a current of 0.5 A. What is its resistance?
How much work is done when 5 C of charge moves through a potential difference of 12 V?
A resistor has a voltage of 9 V and a current of 3 A. How much charge passes in 10 s?
questions.explanation: First find current is given: I = 3 A. Q = It = 3 A × 10 s = 30 C.

questions.question: A wire of resistance 8 Ω is cut into two equal pieces. What is the resistance of each piece?
questions.explanation: Resistance is proportional to length. Cutting the wire in half halves the length, so each piece has resistance 8 Ω / 2 = 4 Ω.

questions.question: Two identical wires are connected in parallel. How does the total resistance compare to one wire?
questions.explanation: For two identical resistors R in parallel: 1/R_total = 1/R + 1/R = 2/R, so R_total = R/2. Total resistance is half.

questions.question: A circuit has a total resistance of 20 Ω and a current of 0.4 A. What is the supply voltage?
A 240 V mains supply delivers 5 A to a heater. How much charge flows in 1 minute?
questions.explanation: Q = It = 5 A × 60 s = 300 C. Wait, 5 × 60 = 300. Option 1 is 300 C. Correct is 300 C.
